comment: Hand-maintained parameter types for tools/gen-natives.cs: native id -> parameter name -> "Type" or "Type newName", and "result": "bool" for a predicate (its doc says 1 or 0, a flag, a check) whose int result the shipped scripts use only as a condition (Common.PadIsPressedRaw and Btl.ActorPartnerReady nearly only; their few value uses read AsInt(...)). The types are the enums of src/Ffx.Atel.Game/Enums.g.cs (tools/gen-enums.cs) and TextId (a message of the script's table, written Text[n]). Sources: each native's doc (data/natives.json, from ffx-rust symbols/ffx.sym) names the argument (actor selector, property, command, motion, msg); the property ids are MsGetChrStatInfo's (ffx-rust docs/formats/battle.md). The "docs" section: per native a modder-facing "summary" (and optionally a verified "name", "rename" of parameters and "params" descriptions), written from what is verified (ffx-rust symbols/ffx.sym without its '?' guesses, the ported natives in ffx-rust crates/ffx-script/src/vm/bridge/, the Ghidra dump); the symbol's notes then go to <remarks>. tools/gen-natives.cs fails on names that mislead ("Ret").

0x011b.summary: Shows sprite <paramref name="slot"/> (0-127) with the picture data in a script variable; returns the slot.

params.data: The variable holding the sprite's data (its address is taken).

0x011c.summary: Hides sprite <paramref name="slot"/>; returns the slot.

0x603b.summary: Sets the camera's screen depth (projection distance): larger is more zoomed in. Returns the camera.

params.depth: The projection distance, for example 404, 624 or 1024.

0x603a.summary: Sets the camera's roll, in degrees. Returns the camera.

0x0129.summary: Sets sprite <paramref name="slot"/>'s colour. Note the order: red, blue, green (each 0-255). Returns the slot.

0x0120.summary: Scales sprite <paramref name="slot"/>; 1.0 is its normal size. Returns the slot.

0x6032.summary: Eases the camera's focus point to its target over <paramref name="accel"/> + <paramref name="hold"/> + <paramref name="decelFrames"/> frames.

0x6014.summary: Eases the camera's eye to its target over <paramref name="accelFrames"/> + <paramref name="holdFrames"/> + <paramref name="decelFrames"/> frames (speeding up, steady, slowing down).

0x011f.summary: Moves sprite <paramref name="slot"/> to screen position (x, y). Returns the slot.

0x009e.summary: Sets text variable <paramref name="slot"/> of message window <paramref name="window"/>: the value a message shows where its text has that variable (a number, an item name, …). Returns the window.

params.type: What the value is (a number, an item, …).

0x601a.summary: Waits until the camera's eye has stopped moving.

0x6038.summary: Waits until the camera's focus point has stopped moving.

0x5000.summary: Sets the worker's model to motion <paramref name="motion"/>.

0x7018.summary: Sets a battle property (HP, status, …) of every actor the selector picks.

0x0065.summary: Places message window <paramref name="window"/> at (x, y) on the screen, by <paramref name="anchor"/>.

params.anchor: Which point of the window (x, y) is.

0x0066.summary: Sets message window <paramref name="window"/>'s style byte (scripts mostly pass 0 or 1). Returns the window.

0x006a.summary: Opens message window <paramref name="window"/> and shows its text (set before with <see cref="MsgSetText"/>). Returns the window.

params.mode: How the window opens; with choices, how many.

0x009d.summary: Sets message window <paramref name="window"/>'s flags (style and behaviour bits; common values 12290, 8194, 0). Returns the window.

0x0064.summary: Puts message <paramref name="msg"/> of the script's text into message window <paramref name="window"/>; <see cref="MsgOpen"/> shows it.

0x006b.summary: Closes message window <paramref name="window"/>. Returns the window.

0x5034.summary: Sets how many frames the worker's model blends into the next motion it starts.

0x505c.summary: Sets how many frames the worker's model blends into its next motion (-1 is 0, 0 is 1).

0x00a9.summary: Returns a random number from 0 to 65535.

0x0033.summary: Returns a worker's id; -1 means this worker.

params.worker: The worker, or -1 for this worker.

0x5025.summary: Sets the motion the model plays by itself in <paramref name="slot"/> (stand, walk, run) when no scripted motion plays; -1 is the default.

0x7015.summary: Prints a value with the actor's index to the debug output.

0x0028.summary: Sets the yaw the worker turns to (see <see cref="TurnStart"/>); returns it wrapped into one turn.

0x0019.summary: Starts the turn set up with the Turn natives; <see cref="TurnWait"/> waits for it.

0x6020.summary: Sets the point the camera looks at.

0x013f.summary: Returns text <paramref name="entry"/> of the game's name dictionary <paramref name="dictionary"/>.

0x6004.summary: Places the camera's eye around the point it looks at: angles in degrees and a distance.

0x8002.summary: Restarts map effect <paramref name="fpId"/> from its start (<paramref name="restart"/> 1) or ends it (0). Returns <paramref name="restart"/>.

0x507e.name: SetAutoTalkOf
0x507e.summary: Turns automatic mouth movement (talking) of another worker's model on or off (<c>Ch_MouthSetAutoTalk</c>); <see cref="SetAutoTalk"/> does it for this worker.

0x001a.summary: Waits until the worker's move (<see cref="MoveStart"/>) has ended.

0x0015.summary: Sets the point the worker moves to (see <see cref="MoveStart"/>).

0x008f.summary: Returns 1 when message window <paramref name="window"/> is ready for a new message, else 0.

0x005f.summary: Waits for ever: the entry stays here until something interrupts it.

0x0018.summary: Starts the move set up with the Move natives (walk, run, jump); <see cref="MoveWait"/> waits for it.

0x0095.summary: Turns the worker to <paramref name="yaw"/> at once; returns it wrapped.

0x00a6.summary: Returns a random number from 0 to <paramref name="n"/> - 1.

0x001f.summary: Returns the yaw from the worker to its move target.

0x4013.summary: Sets light <paramref name="light"/>'s colour and direction.

0x5003.summary: Waits until the worker's model has finished its motion.

0x700f.summary: Returns a battle property of the actors the selector picks (averaged over them).

0x501a.summary: Plays motion <paramref name="motion"/> on the worker's model, from <paramref name="startFrame"/> to <paramref name="endFrame"/> (-1 = its end), <paramref name="loops"/> times.

0x007c.summary: Waits for the message window to be closed (the player read the message).

0x5008.summary: Hides (1) or shows (0) the worker's model.

0x0035.summary: Turns off one kind of trigger of the worker (bit <paramref name="kind"/>; kind 0 is talking to it).

0x0034.summary: Turns on one kind of trigger of the worker (bit <paramref name="kind"/>; kind 0 is talking to it).

0x500f.summary: Turns the worker's body collision on (1) or off (0).

0x001b.summary: Waits until the worker's turn (<see cref="TurnStart"/>) has ended.

0x00fd.summary: Plays sound effect <paramref name="sfx"/> with a pan and a volume (0-127). Returns the sound.

0x001d.summary: Sets how long the worker's next turn takes.

0x00f4.summary: Returns the yaw from the worker to point (x, z); y is ignored.

0x01d1.name: WaitFramesUnlessHddMode
0x01d1.summary: Waits <paramref name="frames"/> frames, or not at all when the game runs in HDD mode (<c>g_FFXHddMode</c>).

0x00d8.summary: Returns 1 while a voice line plays, else 0.

0x00df.summary: Plays sound effect <paramref name="sfx"/> at the default pan and full volume. Returns the sound.

0x0046.summary: Returns the buttons pressed this frame, as bits.

0x0097.summary: Returns message window <paramref name="window"/>'s state: 0 closed, 1 opening, 2 open, 3 closing.

0x8009.summary: Attaches map effect <paramref name="fpId"/> to a bone of the worker's model.

0x800b.summary: Detaches map effect <paramref name="fpId"/> from the worker (0 or less: all).

0x0013.summary: Moves the worker (and its model) to (x, y, z) at once.

0x0126.summary: Moves the worker (and its model) to (x, y, z) at once.

0x6016.summary: Ends the camera eye's move: it jumps to its target now.

0x6034.summary: Ends the camera focus point's move: it jumps to its target now.

0x0001.summary: Loads model <paramref name="model"/> for the worker, in place of the one it had.

0x019c.summary: Returns 1. The scripts test it inside conditions; on PC it is always true.

0x5005.summary: Ends the scripted motion, so that the model's own stand, walk and run motions take over.

0x00c7.summary: Returns the turn motion for a turn kind (from <see cref="GetTurnKind"/>).

0x006c.summary: Sets the worker's move speed (NPCs start at 16, the player at 34).

0x7005.summary: Returns whether the battle is underwater.

0x1006.summary: Returns the square root of <paramref name="x"/>.

0x0042.summary: Binds the worker to a party member (0 Tidus, 1 Yuna, …; -1 for an NPC).

0x0213.summary: Returns the bone of the worker's model that attachment point <paramref name="point"/> is on, 0 if none.

0x5009.summary: Sets how far the worker is pushed when it collides with another; returns the previous weight.

0x500e.summary: Keeps the worker's model on the ground (1) or lets it move freely in 3D (0).

0x00bb.summary: Sets how many frames the fade of the next map change takes.

0x00bc.summary: Sets the kind of fade of the next map change.

0x0060.name: WorkerSetFlag200To
0x0060.summary: Sets (1) or clears (0) the worker's flag <c>0x200</c> (<c>Atel_SetWorkerFlag200</c>), as <see cref="WorkerSetFlag200"/> and <see cref="WorkerClearFlag200"/> do, and restores the player's control.

0x0241.name: SetFieldFlag08
0x0241.summary: Sets (1) or clears (0) bit 3 of the current map's state flags; returns whether set.

0x703b.name: SetCommandUse
0x703b.summary: Calls <c>MsSetCommandUse</c> for each actor the selector picks; returns how many.

0x00d1.name: StopMoveAllLevels
0x00d1.summary: Stops the worker's moves on every level (<c>Script_StopMove</c> for levels 0-8).
